description: Blackbird is a quantum assembly language for continuous-variable quantum computation, that can be used to program Xanadu's quantum photonics hardware and Strawberry Fields simulator.
whatItIs: blackbird is an open-source project in the photonics category. It is maintained by XanaduAI and primarily looks like a C++ codebase. Blackbird is a quantum assembly language for continuous-variable quantum computation, that can be used to program Xanadu's quantum photonics hardware and Strawberry Fields simulator.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches photonics workflows in practice.
